lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgTiO₃ adopts the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—2 Mg, 2 Ti, and 6 O—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ti centers with 6 O neighbors in an octahedral motif, while Mg centers have 4 O neighbors and O centers coordinate to 3 Ti atoms. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-sharing between Ti octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Ti octahedra and Mg 4-vertex coordination polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
